evidence_mode: static managed bodies and compiled data; no execution

claims.claim: Ranked goals and weighted regressive action planning coexist with separate social/demographic passes.
Normal frontend pays remaining legacy points before successor confirmation; channel transfer policies differ.
TransferInformation copies then removes the destination secret-knowledge key; ordinary information moves.
Main teaching route composes institution, calendar, alertness, punishment, prior-study and school branches.
Protobuf authored data carries event instruction bytes; custom host-bound interpreter and node/map state drive events.
Active reading defaults cost one time and three intelligence; batch progress and physical/reference knowledge differ.
Per-art and current-force clamps are separate; elemental benefit/disorder and allocated reserve have separate consumers.
Local marriage and restricted distant marriage have executable state mutation, not only profiles.
Nine additional config tables have complete constructor-ID enumeration; semantic coverage remains partial.

proposals.title: Give a named NPC a real need and several lawful or world-fitting means, with a visible reason for the chosen plan.
proposals.acceptance: One NPC lacks a page, seeks a known teacher, pays time, can be refused and retains progress.

proposals.title: Keep the physical manual, known page variants, comprehension and useful practice separate.
proposals.acceptance: A damaged copy plus a matching reference changes study and later use without silently repairing the object.

proposals.title: Specify succession per channel, including pending work and private knowledge, with explicit move/copy/merge/reset policies.
proposals.acceptance: A successor receives the selected channels, keeps their own bonds and cannot duplicate settlement on reload/import.

proposals.title: Compose teaching access from actual social, institutional, knowledge and availability predicates.
proposals.acceptance: Two teachers can give different concrete refusal reasons and each has a reachable alternate route.

proposals.title: Author an adventure with separate eligibility, entry cost, branch state, exit and world aftermath.
proposals.acceptance: A paid branch changes a later visit; leaving and completing settle different authored consequences.

proposals.title: Let a local coalition form, lose members and respond to a public act through jurisdiction.
proposals.acceptance: One witnessed act changes support and duties only for the actors/institution that know it.

proposals.title: Keep force reserve, method-earned capacity and allocated benefits distinct.
proposals.acceptance: Two methods change useful outcomes differently, with a visible recovery/improvement route.
